rules.title: ipam normalize client_ip from dfp_qip
rules.description: CSP CubeJS dfp_top_qip rows carry the querier IP in dfp_qip. Promote it to client_ip so the IPAM enrichment chain (PTR + DHCP) fires for the Infoblox CubeJS / IQ-MCP dashboard pages.
rules.source:
rule "ipam normalize client_ip from dfp_qip"
when
  has_field("dfp_qip") &&
  !has_field("client_ip")
then
  set_field("client_ip", to_string($message.dfp_qip));
end
